editorial.name: Laravel Cloud
editorial.descriptionZh: Laravel Cloud 是官方出的托管云，把 Laravel 应用的构建、部署、数据库、缓存、对象存储和 WebSocket 都接过去，每个 PR 还会自动开预览环境。首页按 Deploy、Run、Scale 三段讲，另有一个私有云版本。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看托管服务怎么用代码评审流做首屏演示
editorial.noteZh: 域名 cloud.laravel.com 现在落在 laravel.com/cloud。顶部一条蓝底公告写 Live Sept. 24: Watch Laravel founder Taylor Otwell deploy Rails, Laravel, Go, Node, and Python all at once. 加一个 Register 按钮。首屏主标 The managed cloud for Laravel，副标是 The best place to deploy, run, and scale Laravel applications. Push your code and walk away. We'll handle everything else.，下面并排 Deploy、Run、Scale 三个标签。正文 Deploy 段模拟了一段 GitHub 流：francisco madeira · [cloud-5192] add managed queues support for preview environments、ben_tyrer commented Adds a managed queues section to the homepage with a nice illustration.，系统回一句 Preview Environment for b5bc675 was successfully created.。再往下讲 9 regions 覆盖 US、Canada、Europe、Asia Pacific，以及 Flex compute 标着 Scale to zero、Awake hours 4h/mo 与 Pro compute 的常驻模式。

reasons.statement: 这是 Laravel 官方托管云的产品页，Deploy/Run/Scale 三段、预览环境与 compute 计费都在讲它自己的服务，按产品与公司官网归类；候选池来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感清单。
